unit: nlm-rescore (Task B: re-grade of existing adapters with one record per test example)
what: No training. The untuned base, the two local-only adapters and the central adapter (all from ran-nlm-baselines-20261102T090507) and the final federated adapter of ran-nlm-fed-20261102T0911 are scored again on the frozen test text with the same log-likelihood grader, now writing one record per test example (true labels, the log-likelihood of every candidate at the family, cause and action stage, and the choice made) and the SHA-256 of every adapter file and of the test text.

target.metric: family confusion counts of every model, site and true family
target.value: identical to the original scoring jobs (ran-nlm-baselines-20261102T090507 and ran-nlm-fed-score-20261102T093824)
target.direction: exact match expected (same code path, same hardware class). Any difference is reported in GAPS.md, not hidden, and the per-example records become the reported numbers.

model_id: OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (organisers' bucket) + LoRA r=8 alpha=16 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; ran-fl/taskb/model-code/model.py
grader: ran-fl/taskb/taskb_job.py (deterministic: log-likelihood ranking of the candidate FAMILY, CAUSE and ACTION; no model-written labels, no LLM judge)
